item.title: Highlights: Bluefield starts fast in 56-27 win over Philip Barbour; Beavers advance to Class AA final - WV MetroNews
item.description: BLUEFIELD, W.Va. — Highlights from No. 2 Bluefield’s 56-27 win over No. 3 Philip Barbour in the Class AA semifinal round. The Beavers (11-2) will face No. 1 Frankfort (13-0) in the WVSSAC Class AA Championship game Saturday, December 6 at noon.
